_doc: Mix settings applied by tools/build_reaper.py (keys: mockup-kit/pipeline/example-config/mix.json, mockup-kit/LEARNINGS.md sections 12-14). Scherzo c00 (port, 2026-11-07): Movement I series 2's mix at its c43 state (symphony/mvt1/reaper-v621/build/mix.json) with: percussion, Trumpet 3 (tacet), the second-pass and test tracks removed; every qn-keyed loud_eq removed (keyed to movement I's bars); the celli side high shelf held on (mvt1 switched it off for its coda solo); Movement II's later fixes: the side-only low shelves of mvt2 c33 (Double basses 100 Hz -15 dB, Timpani 150 Hz -9, Bass clarinet 250 Hz -6), the woodwind hall send 0.6 (mvt2 c29), Harp env_sustain 1.0 (mvt1 c35 / mvt2 c33); Movement II's Harp harmonics, Violin I solo (1st Violins DIV A) and Violas div (DIV B) entries. Track gains and per-dynamic trims are Movement I's (an Allegro with the same instrumentation); the scherzo's balance is for the loop. c01: critic B #1 Horn 4 soft trims ppp/pp 14/13.5 -> 10/9.5; B #4 bassoon / cor anglais f/ff trims (Bn1 3.5/2.5 -> 0/0, Bn2 4/3 -> 0.5/0.5, CA 2.5/3 -> 0/0.5); C #2 loud_eq at the tuttis 300-360, 900-960, 984-1017 (Movement I's bands, no timpani); C #3 Violas div gain/width; C #4 side low shelves Double basses -15 -> -4, Timpani -9 -> -4; C #6 widths Clarinet 2 / Trumpet 2 0.05, Contrabassoon 0.15. c01 (Dan 2026-11-07, BRIEF S4: too wet, mushy): shared value from the Movement I thread, reverb fx_volume 0.19 -> 0.095 (-6 dB hall return), sends unchanged (full rebuild of every track). Hall low cut 160 Hz (reverb.low_cut_hz, shared value). c02: Horns 1-4 soft_trim_db -> Movement II's c31 values for the soft CC1 map (ppp 4, pp 4, p 4.5, mp 2.8, mf 2.0, own mf kept where higher: Horn 2 2.4, Horn 4 3.3; critic C #1: Movement I's trims, fitted on the low-CC1 layers, compensated the soft map twice: Horn 3 p to ff 3.2 dB); Harp soft_trim_db pp 7 -> 2 (critic B #1: the pp off-beat chords 0.4-6 dB over the p tunes they accompany; its p espress. melody keeps 5).
_c50: mvt1 c50 template mix (tools/make_template_mix.py; keys in tools/TEMPLATE-TOOLS.md): Opus reverb off, REAPER returns per family loaded from the EastWest template's chunks with post-fader sends (profile 'ew'; 'duc' for the section 8 A/B), per-mic levels in dB (mic_db) with Close at the seat and Main/Mid/Surround full width (pan_by_mic), REAPER track pans (reaper_pan), family EQ (family_eq) and the master EQ for the delivery (master_eq). The old keys (mics, width_by_mic, send, reverb) stay for a pass-2 copy of the old layout and are inert where the new ones apply.

_c15: c15 (Dan 2026-11-11; critic B #2): env_simplify_db 0.1: build_reaper.py vol_points keeps a volume-envelope point only if the line between its kept neighbours (in REAPER's fader scale, over seconds) misses it by more than 0.1 dB; no kept segment spans more than env_simplify_max_seg_db. cresc_trim_hold release_s 0.5 -> 1.0 (coordinator, Movement II c54: a hold released over a beat writes an unprinted fall of up to 2.5 dB right after a crescendo's arrival; at 2.5 s the woodwinds, celli and basses stood 0.6-1.6 dB higher over whole sections on the simulation, at 1.0 s the fall takes twice as long and the sections move less). Dan's decision (2026-11-11 16:30Z, no per-note volume moves): region_gain_db on 14 tracks = build/pitch_trims.json as per-region volume in the Opus state (build_reaper.py region_gain); Clarinet 1 / 2 _skip_onsets are not compensated.
